about_the_game:
Dive with your friends from any platform into infinite random dungeons with unique and unpredictable layouts in every room.


start your journey by choosing your character from multiple classes

Titan

    Armored titan, covered in ancient metals and with unbreakable wills, stand as immovable defender in the dungeon's halls. Raise your massive shield to withstand the traps set by the Dungeon Master, then proceed forward to navigate and destroy them. Your allies will feel secure knowing you are an unyielding protector by their side, enduring every peril the dungeon presents.

Lifeweaver

    you have incredible abilities to support your team. Heal yourself and your allies remotely, find items that grant extra souls, and even revive eliminated teammates. With unmatched healing powers and the ability to bring back the dead, you will be the ultimate helper, ensuring your team's survival through the darkest challenges.

Wraith

    you are the fastest and most agile class, darting through the dungeon with unmatched speed. Your extra dashes and unique dodge abilities let you avoid danger effortlessly. Only you can face the creatures summoned by the Dungeon Master. Quick, fearless, and essential




    wonder and discover the countless randomly generated maps each one with it's unique and unpredictable layout in every room providing a fresh experience in every match


    As the Dungeon Master ,place traps in the rooms of the dungeon strategically to eliminate the survivors


    Summon and control your creatures to chase and hunt the survivors inside the dungeon




    as the survivor use your doge ability to avoid the traps placed by the dungeon master


    while exploring the dungeon find and loot chests to find items and spells to help you escape from the dungeon


    set your strategy with your teammates else to stay together to help each other , split in different ways to loot and finish as fast as possible or to confuse the dungeon master

name: Dungeon Master

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: core i5 4th gen
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia Geforce GTX 760
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: core i5 7th gen
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia Geforce GTX 1050 or AMD Radeon RX 570
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: In Dungeon Master, you either try to escape a randomly generated dungeon as a survivor or hunt down survivors as the Dungeon Master. It's a cross-platform game where your role determines your goal.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
